description: This file contains driver code for Ralink's MT7620 Ethernet hardware, including functions for MDIO (Management Data Input/Output) operations, PHY link handling, and related utility routines.

methods.name: int mt7620_mii_busy_wait(struct mt7620_gsw * gsw)
methods.description: Waits for MDIO interface to become available or times out.

methods.name: u32 _mt7620_mii_write(struct mt7620_gsw * gsw,u32 phy_addr,u32 phy_register,u32 write_data)
methods.description: Performs a write operation to a PHY register via MDIO.

methods.name: u32 _mt7620_mii_read(struct mt7620_gsw * gsw,int phy_addr,int phy_reg)
methods.description: Performs a read operation from a PHY register via MDIO.

methods.name: int mt7620_mdio_write(struct mii_bus * bus,int phy_addr,int phy_reg,u16 val)
methods.description: Wrapper for writing to PHY registers using MDIO.

methods.name: int mt7620_mdio_read(struct mii_bus * bus,int phy_addr,int phy_reg)
methods.description: Wrapper for reading from PHY registers using MDIO.

methods.name: void mt7530_mdio_w32(struct mt7620_gsw * gsw,u32 reg,u32 val)
methods.description: Writes 32-bit data to a specific MDIO register.

methods.name: u32 mt7530_mdio_r32(struct mt7620_gsw * gsw,u32 reg)
methods.description: Reads 32-bit data from a specific MDIO register.

methods.name: unsigned char * fe_speed_str(int speed)
methods.description: Returns string representation of speed in Mbps.

methods.name: int mt7620_has_carrier(struct fe_priv * priv)
methods.description: Checks if any port has carrier detected.

methods.name: void mt7620_handle_carrier(struct fe_priv * priv)
methods.description: Updates network carrier status based on port status.

methods.name: void mt7620_print_link_state(struct fe_priv * priv,int port,int link,int speed,int duplex)
methods.description: Prints link status information for a port.

methods.name: void mt7620_mdio_link_adjust(struct fe_priv * priv,int port)
methods.description: Adjusts link status and carrier state based on PHY status.
